status_effects.title: Status Effects
status_effects.summary: Combat effects and crowd control applied by hero skills across the battlefield.

entries.name: Knockback
entries.text: Forces enemies backward on hit, creating breathing room for the party.

entries.name: Stun
entries.text: Incapacitates a foe briefly, halting movement and canceling telegraphed attacks mid-cast.

entries.name: Slow
entries.text: Chills enemies with frost, reducing movement speed so rushers fall behind.

entries.name: Burn
entries.text: Ignites targets with fire, dealing steady damage over time until the flames fade.

entries.name: Mark
entries.text: Marks a foe so it takes bonus damage from all party attacks.

entries.name: Taunt
entries.text: Draws enemy aggro, compelling nearby and struck foes to target the Knight.

formation.title: Formation
formation.summary: Guide only your leader - the fellowship holds formation and fights automatically around you.

entries.name: Vanguard & Backline
entries.text: Healers and Ranged allies shelter in the inner rear rings while Melee warriors shield the outer front arc.

entries.name: Marching Formation
entries.text: Standing ground forms a protective circle; moving parts the vanguard and trails allies behind in a crescent.

entries.name: Frontline & Anchors
entries.text: Melee heroes step out to engage nearby foes and regroup as you move; Ranged and Healers hold their posts.

entries.name: Travel Sprint
entries.text: Out of combat, steady movement builds sprint speed to cross cleared chambers swiftly.

squad_and_leveling.title: Squad & Leveling
squad_and_leveling.summary: Expand your fellowship by rescuing lost survivors and upgrading hero classes with battle XP.

entries.name: Rescuing Survivors
entries.text: Reach stranded survivors in dungeon rooms to draft a new ally. Offers favor underrepresented classes.

entries.name: Class Leveling
entries.text: Defeating foes fills squad XP. Upgrading a class restores that class to full health and empowers current and future members.

entries.name: Reroll Coins
entries.text: Gather spinning gold coins hidden in chambers to reroll Recruit or Level-Up offers.

entries.name: Dungeon Potions
entries.text: Walk over scattered flasks for instant squad effects. Collect each variety to log it under Codex Items.

entries.name: Leader's Fate
entries.text: Fallen companions are lost for the run, and the expedition ends immediately if your leader falls.

keys_and_traps.title: Keys & Traps
keys_and_traps.summary: Ascend deeper north by claiming sector keys, opening shortcuts, and navigating dungeon hazards.

entries.name: Sector Keys & Doors
entries.text: Colored doors seal deeper dungeon sectors. Explore side branches to claim the matching key and unlock passage.

entries.name: Shortcut Levers
entries.text: Key chambers conceal wall levers that open direct passages back toward the locked sector door.

entries.name: Spike Traps
entries.text: Timed floor spikes erupt in cycles, harming heroes and monsters alike. Take wide turns so trailing allies stay safe.

entries.name: Dungeon Map
entries.text: Open the map to survey explored rooms, danger levels, keys, and sealed doors.
